item.title: Watch every Alabama touchdown vs Vanderbilt
item.author: Alabama Crimson Tide on AL.com
item.description:
Alabama quarterback Keelon Russell threw three touchdown passes in the Crimson Tide’s 21-6 win over Vanderbilt. Russell connected with Marshall Pritchett for his first score before finding Lotzeir Brooks for two more, the second set up by an 83-yard kickoff return from Dijon Lee Jr.
